lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Chasing the shadow of a neon moon in the haze
Lost in the rhythm of the city's electric maze
Gravity pulling like a magnet deep inside my chest
Finding the motion where the pulse and peace rest
Walking on wires of silver and gold light
Taking the leap into the velvet of the night
Every heartbeat is a drum beat, steady and strong
Dancing to the melody where I finally belong
[Chorus]
Higher than the stars, deeper than the sea
Finding all the magic in the space of me
Electric vibrations moving through the floor
Opening the spirit, knocking down the door
[Verse]
Counting the seconds while the world starts to spin
Letting the fire of the future rush in
A symphony of color painting every single street
Every jagged moment finding rhythm in the beat
No more waiting for the moment to arrive
Feeling the spark that makes the spirit thrive
Floating on waves of a synth-heavy tide
Nowhere to run and nowhere left to hide
[Chorus]
Higher than the stars, deeper than the sea
Finding all the magic in the space of me
Electric vibrations moving through the floor
Opening the spirit, knocking down the door
[Bridge]
The silence is heavy, the pressure is real
Only the truth is the weight that I feel
[Chorus]
Higher than the stars, deeper than the sea
Finding all the magic in the space of me
Electric vibrations moving through the floor
Opening the spirit, knocking down the door
[Outro]
